feature: Pengecualian jenis kendaraan saat Toppan generate letter: kendaraan Foreign di-PS-FOR ulang, Military/Diplomatic di-PS-MID/PS-DIP, VIP di-TS-CLV di RR3/DR3
note: Saat memilih notice untuk letter, cron Toppan membuang kendaraan Foreign tanpa PS-FOR aktif dan memasang ulang PS-FOR, membuang kendaraan Military/Diplomatic di RR3/DR3 lalu memasang PS-MID/PS-DIP, dan memasang TS-CLV untuk kendaraan VIP setelah RR3/DR3. Dibaca di code; belum dicocokkan ke story epic lain (kemungkinan terkait OCMS17 atau epic kendaraan khusus).
note_en: When selecting notices for a letter, the Toppan cron drops Foreign vehicles without an active PS-FOR and re-applies PS-FOR, drops Military/Diplomatic vehicles at RR3/DR3 and applies PS-MID/PS-DIP, and applies TS-CLV to VIP vehicles after RR3/DR3. Read in the code; not matched to stories of other epics (possibly OCMS17 or a special-vehicle epic).

feature: TS-HST otomatis untuk offender yang berhasil di-eNotify (cek ocms_hst setelah kirim SMS/email)
note: Setelah SMS/email berhasil, NotificationSmsEmailJob mengecek ID offender ke ocms_hst dalam satu query batch lalu memasang TS-HST per notice (retry sekali). Dibaca di code; belum dicocokkan ke story HST di epic lain.
note_en: After a successful SMS/email, NotificationSmsEmailJob checks the offender IDs against ocms_hst in one batch query and applies TS-HST per notice (one retry). Read in the code; not matched to HST stories in other epics.
